description: This file provides utility functions for handling REST API interactions, including base URL resolution, URL construction, and error message mapping, specifically tailored for an Angular frontend application.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the absolute backend API base URL, derived from browser location or environment configuration, with domain and port rewriting for production and preview environments.

methods.name: apiUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full API URL by appending a given path to the base URL, normalizing the path format.

methods.name: toUserFriendlyApiError
methods.description: Converts an HttpErrorResponse or other error into a user-friendly message, with logging for debugging.
